policies.name: authentication-basic
policies.description: Authenticates with a backend service using Basic authentication.

policies.name: authentication-certificate
policies.description: Authenticates with a backend service using a client certificate.

policies.name: authentication-managed-identity
policies.description: Authenticates with a backend service using a managed identity.

policies.name: azure-openai-emit-token-metric
policies.description: Legacy name of llm-emit-token-metric, kept for existing policies.

policies.name: azure-openai-semantic-cache-lookup
policies.description: Legacy name of llm-semantic-cache-lookup, kept for existing policies.

policies.name: azure-openai-semantic-cache-store
policies.description: Legacy name of llm-semantic-cache-store, kept for existing policies.

policies.name: azure-openai-token-limit
policies.description: Legacy name of llm-token-limit, kept for existing policies.

policies.name: cache-lookup
policies.description: Looks up a cached response and returns it when a valid entry exists.

policies.name: cache-lookup-value
policies.description: Retrieves a cached item by key into a context variable.

policies.name: cache-remove-value
policies.description: Removes a cached item by key.

policies.name: cache-store
policies.description: Caches the response according to the specified cache control configuration.

policies.name: cache-store-value
policies.description: Stores an item in the cache by key.

policies.name: check-header
policies.description: Enforces existence and/or value of an HTTP request header.

policies.name: choose
policies.description: Conditionally applies policy statements based on Boolean expressions.

policies.name: cors
policies.description: Adds cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) support to an API or operation.

policies.name: cosmosdb-data-source
policies.description: Configures a Cosmos DB request and optional response to resolve a GraphQL field.

policies.name: cross-domain
policies.description: Makes the API accessible from Adobe Flash and Microsoft Silverlight clients.

policies.name: emit-metric
policies.description: Sends custom metrics to Application Insights.

policies.name: find-and-replace
policies.description: Finds a substring in the request or response body and replaces it with another.

policies.name: forward-request
policies.description: Forwards the request to the backend service.

policies.name: get-authorization-context
policies.description: Gets the authorization context of a connection to a credential provider.

policies.name: http-data-source
policies.description: Configures an HTTP request and optional response to resolve a GraphQL field.

policies.name: include-fragment
policies.description: Inserts a policy fragment into the policy definition.

policies.name: invoke-dapr-binding
policies.description: Uses the Dapr runtime to invoke an external system through an output binding.

policies.name: ip-filter
policies.description: Allows or denies calls from specific IP addresses and address ranges.

policies.name: json-to-xml
policies.description: Converts a request or response body from JSON to XML.
policies.example: <json-to-xml apply="always" consider-accept-header="false" parse-date="false" namespace-separator=":" namespace-prefix="xmlns" attribute-block-name="#attrs" />

policies.name: jsonp
policies.description: Adds JSON with padding (JSONP) support to an API or operation.

policies.name: limit-concurrency
policies.description: Limits how many requests can execute the enclosed policies at the same time.

policies.name: llm-content-safety
policies.description: Checks LLM prompts against Azure AI Content Safety before they reach the backend.
policies.example:
<llm-content-safety backend-id="content-safety-backend" shield-prompt="true">
    <categories output-type="EightSeverityLevels">
        <category name="Hate" threshold="4" />
        <category name="Violence" threshold="4" />
    </categories>
</llm-content-safety>

policies.name: llm-emit-token-metric
policies.description: Sends LLM token consumption metrics to Application Insights.

policies.name: llm-semantic-cache-lookup
policies.description: Returns a cached LLM response based on semantic similarity of the prompt.

policies.name: llm-semantic-cache-store
policies.description: Caches an LLM response for later semantic cache lookups.

policies.name: llm-token-limit
policies.description: Limits LLM token consumption per key by rate, quota, or both.

policies.name: log-to-eventhub
policies.description: Sends a message to an event hub defined by a logger.
policies.example:
<log-to-eventhub logger-id ='contoso-logger'>
  @( string.Join(",", DateTime.UtcNow, context.Deployment.ServiceName, context.RequestId, context.Request.IpAddress, context.Operation.Name) )
</log-to-eventhub>

policies.name: mock-response
policies.description: Aborts the pipeline and returns a mocked response to the caller.

policies.name: proxy
policies.description: Routes forwarded requests through an HTTP proxy.

policies.name: publish-event
policies.description: Publishes an event to GraphQL subscriptions from a resolver.

policies.name: publish-to-dapr
policies.description: Uses the Dapr runtime to publish a message to a pub/sub topic.

policies.name: quota
policies.description: Enforces a renewable or lifetime call volume and/or bandwidth quota per subscription.

policies.name: quota-by-key
policies.description: Enforces a renewable or lifetime call volume and/or bandwidth quota per key.

policies.name: rate-limit
policies.description: Limits the call rate per subscription to prevent usage spikes.

policies.name: rate-limit-by-key
policies.description: Limits the call rate per key to prevent usage spikes.

policies.name: redirect-content-urls
policies.description: Rewrites links in the response body so they point to the gateway.

policies.name: retry
policies.description: Retries the enclosed policies until a condition is met or the retry count is reached.
policies.example:
<retry
    condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode == 500)"
    count="10"
    interval="10"
    max-interval="100"
    delta="10"
    first-fast-retry="false">
        <forward-request buffer-request-body="true" />
</retry>

policies.name: return-response
policies.description: Aborts the pipeline and returns the specified response to the caller.

policies.name: rewrite-uri
policies.description: Converts a request URL from its public form to the form the backend expects.

policies.name: send-one-way-request
policies.description: Sends a request to a URL without waiting for a response.
policies.example:
<send-one-way-request mode="new" timeout="20">
    <set-url>https://example.com/webhook</set-url>
    <set-method>POST</set-method>
    <set-body>@{ return new JObject(new JProperty("text", context.Request.Url.Path)).ToString(); }</set-body>
</send-one-way-request>

policies.name: send-request
policies.description: Sends a request to a URL and stores the response in a variable.
policies.example:
<send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="tokenstate" timeout="20" ignore-error="true">
    <set-url>https://microsoft-apiappec990ad4c76641c6aea22f566efc5a4e.azurewebsites.net/introspection</set-url>
    <set-method>POST</set-method>
    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
        <value>application/x-www-form-urlencoded</value>
    </set-header>
    <set-body>@($"token={(string)context.Variables["token"]}")</set-body>
</send-request>

policies.name: send-service-bus-message
policies.description: Sends a message to an Azure Service Bus queue or topic.

policies.name: set-backend-service
policies.description: Changes the backend base URL of the request to a URL or a backend entity.

policies.name: set-body
policies.description: Sets the message body of a request or response.

policies.name: set-header
policies.description: Adds, replaces or deletes an HTTP header.

policies.name: set-method
policies.description: Changes the HTTP method of the request.

policies.name: set-query-parameter
policies.description: Adds, replaces or deletes a request query string parameter.

policies.name: set-status
policies.description: Changes the HTTP status code of the response.

policies.name: set-variable
policies.description: Persists a value in a named context variable for later use.

policies.name: sql-data-source
policies.description: Configures an Azure SQL request and optional response to resolve a GraphQL field.
policies.example:
<sql-data-source>
    <connection-info>
        <connection-string>
            {{my-connection-string}}
        </connection-string>
    </connection-info>
    <request single-result="true">
        <sql-statement>
            SELECT f.[Id] AS [id], f.[Name] AS [name] FROM Family f WHERE @familyId = f.[Id]
        </sql-statement>
        <parameters>
            <parameter name="@familyId">
                @(context.GraphQL.Arguments["id"])
            </parameter>
        </parameters>
    </request>
</sql-data-source>

policies.name: trace
policies.description: Adds a custom trace to the request tracing output and Application Insights.
policies.example:
<trace source="PetStore API" severity="verbose">
    <message>@((string)context.Variables["clientConnectionID"])</message>
    <metadata name="Operation Name" value="New-Order"/>
</trace>

policies.name: validate-azure-ad-token
policies.description: Validates a Microsoft Entra ID JWT from a header, query parameter or token value.

policies.name: validate-client-certificate
policies.description: Validates the client certificate against specified rules and claims.
policies.example:
<validate-client-certificate
    validate-revocation="true"
    validate-trust="true"
    validate-not-before="true"
    validate-not-after="true"
    ignore-error="false">
    <identities>
        <identity
            subject="CN=*.contoso.com"
            issuer-subject="CN=FabrikamSign Root CA" />
    </identities>
</validate-client-certificate>

policies.name: validate-content
policies.description: Validates the size or content of a request or response body against API schemas.
policies.example:
<validate-content unspecified-content-type-action="prevent" max-size="102400" size-exceeded-action="prevent" errors-variable-name="requestBodyValidation">
    <content-type-map missing-content-type-value="application/json">
        <type from="application/hal+json" to="application/json" />
    </content-type-map>
    <content type="application/json" validate-as="json" action="detect" allow-additional-properties="false" />
</validate-content>

policies.name: validate-graphql-request
policies.description: Validates and authorizes a request to a GraphQL API.
policies.example:
<validate-graphql-request error-variable-name="name" max-size="102400" max-depth="4">
    <authorize>
        <rule path="/__*" action="reject" />
        <rule path="/Missions/name" action="@(context.Request.Headers.Count > 2 ? "remove" : "allow")" />
    </authorize>
</validate-graphql-request>

policies.name: validate-headers
policies.description: Validates response headers against the API schema.

policies.name: validate-jwt
policies.description: Validates a JWT from a header, query parameter or token value.

policies.name: validate-odata-request
policies.description: Validates a request to an OData API against the OData specification.

policies.name: validate-parameters
policies.description: Validates request header, query and path parameters against the API schema.
policies.example:
<validate-parameters specified-parameter-action="prevent" unspecified-parameter-action="prevent" errors-variable-name="requestParametersValidation">
    <headers specified-parameter-action="detect" unspecified-parameter-action="detect">
        <parameter name="Authorization" action="prevent" />
        <parameter name="User-Agent" action="ignore" />
        <parameter name="Host" action="ignore" />
        <parameter name="Referrer" action="ignore" />
    </headers>
</validate-parameters>

policies.name: validate-status-code
policies.description: Validates response status codes against the API schema.

policies.name: wait
policies.description: Waits for enclosed send-request, cache-lookup-value or choose policies to complete.

policies.name: xml-to-json
policies.description: Converts a request or response body from XML to JSON.

policies.name: xsl-transform
policies.description: Applies an XSL transformation to the XML request or response body.
policies.example:
<xsl-transform>
    <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
        <xsl:output omit-xml-declaration="yes" method="xml" indent="yes" />
        <xsl:template match="node()| @*|*">
            <xsl:copy>
                <xsl:apply-templates select="@* | node()|*" />
            </xsl:copy>
        </xsl:template>
    </xsl:stylesheet>
</xsl-transform>
